software-engineering/fde-role-sdlc-and-h.summary: What a Forward Deployed Engineer does, the SDLC stages you will practise, and how Section 1 (foundations), Section 2 (customer delivery), and Section 3 (capstone) fit together.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: This hour sets context before Python and FastAPI. You are learning how real customer engagements run—not building the Ask IT app yet.

sections.heading: What an FDE does
sections.body:
- Works with the customer on discovery, design, build, validation, deploy, and handover.
- Turns fuzzy requests into working software with clear acceptance checks.
- Uses AI tools and engineering discipline together—not only coding in isolation.

sections.heading: SDLC in this course
sections.body:
- **Discover & requirements** — Stages 3–4 (business, UI/UX).
- **Architecture** — Stage 5.
- **Build & test** — Stage 6.
- **Pilot & production** — Stages 7–8.
- **Operate & handover** — Stage 9.
- **Capstone** — Stage 10 applies everything on e-commerce projects.

objectives: Explain what an FDE does in plain language
Name the main SDLC phases you will practise from Stage 3 onward
Describe how Section 1 skills (Python and FastAPI) connect to the Ask IT customer flow and capstone
